title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Natulongan, Municipality of Kibawe , Province of Bukidnon, to Be Known as the Kibawe National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Natulongan, Municipality of Kibawe , Province of Bukidnon, to Be Known as the Kibawe National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Natulongan, Thị trấn Kibawe, Tỉnh Bukidnon được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Kibawe
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Natulongan, เทศบาล Kibawe, จังหวัด Bukidnon ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Kibawe
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Natulongan, Kotamadya Kibawe, Provinsi Bukidnon dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Kibawe
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Natulongan, Perbandaran Kibawe, Wilayah Bukidnon dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Kibawe

text.en: There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a national high school in Barangay Natulongan, Municipality of Kibawe, Province of Bukidnon, to be known as the Kibawe National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue the necessary rules and regulations for the effective implementation of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
